cells.gaps: No source found says the strategy has been adopted or validated: it was presented and launched at the national AI forum in September 2026, and in January 2026 the workshop on its draft was held in preparation for its official adoption. No body named to carry it out has been found.
cells.note: Bill's ruling (messages-for-bill 132): a launch is not adoption, and formal validation is needed. The 2026-2030 strategy was presented and launched in September 2026 with no adoption stated, so stage 2.
